assets.title: Vase between two female chimeras
assets.description: An upright engraved panel. A lidded fluted vase with a bearded mask on its bowl stands at the centre on a pair of scaly serpent coils; a female chimera stands at either side, with a woman's head and torso, a scaled lower body curling into a serpent tail and lion-pawed feet, each gripping the vase rim. From the vase rise acanthus leaves and thin stems that curl symmetrically into two large tulip-like flowers, two round blossoms and small leaf tendrils up to a central finial. Black and grey line work with cream paper-toned fills; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Tall upright panel (about 1 to 2); the chimeras and the vase form its base, so place it standing, not rotated.

assets.title: Bearded mask with eagle, cornucopias and fauns
assets.description: A nearly rectangular engraved grotesque. A large bearded mask with a furrowed brow stares out from the centre under a pine-cone finial on a stand; two fruit-filled cornucopias hung with ribbons flank it, and a parrot-like bird perches on a scroll in each upper corner. At the lower sides two horned fauns with scaled fish tails face inward, holding a cloth that drapes behind an eagle with spread wings and talons at the bottom centre. Brown-black line work with cream paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Dense near-rectangular panel (about 3 to 4); it reads as a plate or a tile, not as a border.

assets.title: Grotesque with mask, goat heads and children
assets.description: A nearly rectangular engraved grotesque. A large bearded mask with an open mouth fills the centre; above it a small bearded man sits astride its crest and stretches a cloth to two horned goat heads in the upper corners, while a booted man in a jerkin perches on a cornucopia at either side. Below, a nude child rides a woman's bust at the left and another stands on a bearded satyr's head at the right; a lion mask with a draped cloth and a small lower mask among acanthus leaves close the bottom. Brown-black line work with cream paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Dense near-rectangular panel (about 3 to 4); it reads as a plate or a tile, not as a border.

assets.title: Branching leaf scroll with bell flower
assets.description: A horizontal foliate ornament. From a leafy base at the bottom centre a straight stem rises to a bell-shaped flower on a ringed collar, and symmetrical stems branch to either side, curling into volutes dressed with broad lobed leaves and drooping buds. Tan-cream fills with dark brown hatching on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Reads as a headpiece or tailpiece; the central flower marks the axis.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1912.85

assets.title: Putto gripping a wide leaf scroll
assets.description: A wide horizontal foliate panel. A nude putto crouches at the centre with its head turned to the left, gripping the stems that run through both hands, while a small bell flower rises above its head; broad lobed leaves on thin curling stems spread symmetrically to both ends, with a small bud at each edge. Brown-black line work with cream and tan paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: The scroll is cut by the plate edge at both ends; it suits a headpiece or a band but will not tile.

assets.title: Candelabrum with female-headed beasts and lizards
assets.description: A tall candelabrum grotesque. A hairy mask at the top holds ribbons and stems in its mouth; below it two feline-bodied beasts with raised tails stand back to back, their long necks ending in two women's heads at the sides, and a blank tablet hangs between them above a palmette. Two flaming bowls stand on fluted brackets at the sides, and two lizard-like beasts grip the stems at the bottom around a cup with ears of grain. Tan-cream fills with dark brown hatching on a transparent background.
usage_notes: The blank tablet in the middle can carry a short caption.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O2013.2

assets.title: Candelabrum with fish and roses
assets.description: A tall narrow symmetrical foliate candelabrum. A thin central shaft rises through tiers of acanthus leaves and volutes; two fish-tailed dolphins with open jaws face each other across the middle, two more look outward at the base, and round roses sit in the volutes near the top under a small finial. Black and grey line work with cream paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Very tall piece (about 1 to 3); it suits a page margin or a vertical separator at full height.

assets.title: Fluted vase with trumpet horns and leaf scroll
assets.description: A horizontal foliate ornament. A gadrooned vase at the bottom centre sends up a straight stem with layered acanthus leaves, and two flared trumpet-shaped horns lean outward above it; broad curled leaves, hanging bell flowers and pea-pod-like buds spread symmetrically to both sides, with a bell flower cut off at each edge. Brown-black line work with cream and tan paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Reads as a headpiece or tailpiece with the vase as its base.

assets.title: Leafy shaft with bearded mask and lion mask
assets.description: A tall narrow symmetrical foliate ornament. From a hairy bearded mask at the base, flanked by two pod-like gourds on curled stems that end in lion paws, a central shaft rises through a lion mask set in a shield-shaped cartouche, two roses, a ribbon and a bearded mask with wild hair, up to a leafy calyx with two volute horns, beads and hanging buds at the top; thin acanthus stems curl outward along the whole height. Black line work with cream paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Very tall piece (about 1 to 3); it suits a page margin or a vertical separator at full height.

assets.title: Leafy stems on a hairy base
assets.description: A narrow upright strip cut from the Ornament with Naked Couple sheet. Grass-like stalks with small lobed leaves and buds rise from a rounded tuft of hair-like hatching at the bottom; the left side is a straight cut where the couple stood in the print. Black line work with cream paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Crop from the same sheet as the couple and the tall grotesque; the straight left edge is where it abutted the couple, so place something against that side or keep it at the right of a composition.

assets.title: Nude couple standing
assets.description: A nude man and woman stand side by side, cut from the Ornament with Naked Couple sheet. The woman at the left faces the viewer with her head turned toward the man, her braided hair streaming out to the left, a girdle at her hips and a small rod held upright in her right hand; the man at the right stands in profile facing left, one arm around her shoulders and his open hand under hers. Fine black engraved hatching with cream paper-toned skin on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Crop from the same sheet as the leafy stems and the tall grotesque; the figures touch at shoulder, hands and feet and must stay together.

assets.title: Two horns with vine-leaf scroll
assets.description: A wide horizontal foliate panel. Two short horns rise from a central pair of volutes and are tied together by a bow at the top, with an upright vine leaf between them; broad lobed leaves on curling stems spread symmetrically to both ends, with volutes along the base and a curled leaf at each outer corner. Brown-black line work with cream and tan paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete at both ends; reads as a headpiece or a band.

assets.title: Tendril panel with AG monogram
assets.description: A horizontal opaque engraved panel on a dark cross-hatched ground. A stem rises from a small block bearing the AG monogram at the bottom centre to a bud at the top, and two leafy tendrils curl outward from it into large volutes at either end, with lobed leaves filling the corners. Cream leaves on a black hatched ground; only the margin outside the panel is transparent.
usage_notes: Opaque panel with its original hatched ground; place it as a plate, not as a cut-out.
The AG monogram at the bottom centre is part of the print and should stay visible.

assets.title: Seated putto holding a leaf scroll
assets.description: An upright foliate ornament. A nude putto sits at the bottom centre facing the viewer, holding an upright stem in one hand and a curling stem in the other; from these a tall acanthus scroll branches upward and sideways with broad curled leaves, tulip-like buds and a trumpet flower, filling a roughly rectangular field. Brown-black line work with cream and tan paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: The putto is the base of the composition; keep it upright.

assets.title: Dagger sheath with soldier's head
assets.description: A tall tapering ornament designed for a dagger sheath. At the top a helmeted soldier's head in profile faces left inside a wreath of leaves and buds; below it a stem runs down the centre through curled acanthus leaves, a volute and rows of pod-like fruits hanging from short stems, narrowing to a point at the bottom. Black line work with cream paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Very tall and narrow (about 1 to 4.5); it suits a page margin or a vertical rule, head at the top.

assets.title: Candelabrum with sphinxes and cornucopias
assets.description: A tall narrow symmetrical candelabrum grotesque. Two winged sphinxes with women's heads sit back to back at the base, their wings rising into volutes; above them two fruit-filled cornucopias cross under a knotted ribbon, two roses sit in the scrolls, a bearded mask with leafy hair faces out from the upper middle between two butterflies, and two large flowers hang from the volutes under a small vase finial, all joined by thin acanthus stems and strings of beads. Black line work with cream paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Very tall piece (about 1 to 2.8); it suits a page margin or a vertical separator at full height.

assets.title: Grotesque with winged woman and lion heads
assets.description: A tall narrow foliate grotesque cut from the Ornament with Naked Couple sheet. A woman's bust with curled ram's horns and leafy wings faces the viewer at the top under two hanging bell flowers; below her a layered acanthus calyx carries two lion-like heads in profile facing inward, a frowning cat-like mask stares out from the centre, and curled leaves descend to a scalloped cup terminal at the bottom. Black line work with cream paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Very tall piece (about 1 to 3.2); it suits a page margin or a vertical separator at full height.
Crop from the same sheet as the couple and the leafy stems.

assets.title: Leafy shaft with two masks and dolphins
assets.description: A tall narrow symmetrical foliate ornament. Under a leafy crown at the top two bearded grotesque masks in profile face outward; below them two dolphin-like creatures with open jaws curl away from the shaft, two small roses sit on the stems, a fluted collar holds hanging pear-shaped pods, and tiers of broad acanthus leaves, volutes and pea pods descend to a leafy base. Brown-black line work with cream and tan paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Very tall piece (about 1 to 3.4); it suits a page margin or a vertical separator at full height.

assets.title: Two putti in a vine-leaf scroll
assets.description: A wide horizontal foliate panel. A nude boy stands at the far left facing right, one hand on his hip and the other raised to a stem; a second nude boy stands near the centre facing right, grasping a stem above his head and stretching his other arm along the scroll; thin curling stems with broad lobed vine leaves fill the rest of the panel to the right edge. Brown-black line work with cream and tan paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Reads left to right as a headpiece or a band; the figures anchor the left half.

assets.title: Two putti under a tall leaf scroll
assets.description: A tall narrow foliate panel. Two putti sit at the bottom, one in a short tunic facing right behind a nude one facing the viewer, both holding stems; above them a dense scroll of thin stems with lobed leaves, buds and pod-like fruits fills the whole height. Tan-cream fills with dark brown hatching on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Very tall piece (about 1 to 3.3); it suits a page margin at a small size.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1907.751

assets.title: Candelabrum with two pairs of satyrs
assets.description: A tall candelabrum grotesque in two tiers. At the top two satyrs seated on scrolls, a long-haired one at the left and a goat-horned bearded one at the right, raise a tiered fluted vase of foliage with a small lizard among its leaves; a palmette separates the tiers. Below, a female satyr with a plumed headdress at the left and a bearded male at the right sit facing a horned goat skull at the centre, each holding a curved horn; all four have goat legs and hooves. Black line work with cream paper-toned fills on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Upright piece (about 1 to 2); the two tiers can be cropped apart at the palmette if a shorter piece is needed.

assets.title: Urn candelabrum with three tiers of flowers
assets.description: A tall narrow symmetrical candelabrum. From a gadrooned urn at the bottom a central shaft rises through three tiers of paired volutes, each holding a large round flower, past a shouting mask in the lower middle and a blank tablet in the upper middle, to a cup with ears of grain at the top; thin acanthus stems with small leaves and beads fill the sides. Tan-cream fills with dark brown hatching on a transparent background.
usage_notes: The blank tablet in the upper middle can carry a short caption.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1907.754

assets.title: Penwork acanthus tailpiece
assets.description: An upright spray in black penwork rising from a short cut stem at the bottom, a tall curling acanthus leaf in the centre with finely hatched lobes, two large acanthus leaves curling down and outward to the left and right, a small ivy leaf and a thin tendril at the upper right, a tendril at the upper left and a hanging flower bud below the stem, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Place centred below the last paragraph of a chapter or section; pairs with songbirds-headpiece at the head of the text.
Open line art; the interiors of the leaves are transparent, so it reads best on a light ground.

assets.title: Clasped book among ivy
assets.description: A closed book seen from above in three-quarter view, in black penwork, with its spine of raised bands at the left, two strap clasps on the right edge of the hatched front cover, a bevelled cover border with corner bosses, visible page edges and a ribbon bookmark hanging out of the fore-edge at the bottom, surrounded on both sides and below by an ivy vine of pointed leaves and curled tendrils, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete vignette; keep the book and its ivy together and keep the proportions.
Open line art; the cover and page interiors are transparent, so it reads best on a light ground.

assets.title: Gold cinquefoil divider, centre
assets.description: A painted five-petalled flower in textured gold with dark brown contours, pale cream highlights along the petal veins and a dark brown centre, with a short gold stem ending in a round knob on each side, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Centre piece of a flexible divider with gold-cinquefoil-divider-end; draw a continuous rule beneath it so the knobbed stems meet the rule on both sides.
Also works alone as a section mark.

assets.title: Gold ivy-leaf divider terminal
assets.description: A painted divider terminal in textured gold with dark brown contours and pale cream highlights, a three-lobed ivy leaf pointing left with a smaller lobe curling up and one curling down behind it, and a long straight gold stem extending to the right, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Terminal of a flexible divider with gold-cinquefoil-divider-center; the leaf points left and the stem runs right, so as drawn it closes the left end of a rule and is mirrored for the right end.
Draw the connecting rule at the height of the stem.

assets.title: Gold lozenge divider, centre
assets.description: A painted lozenge-shaped fleuron in textured gold with dark brown contours and pale cream highlights, a tall pointed leaf above and below and a curled leaf to the left and right around a small dark brown centre, with a straight gold stem ending in a pointed tip on each side, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Centre piece of a flexible divider with gold-lozenge-divider-end; draw a continuous rule beneath it so the pointed stems meet the rule on both sides.
Also works alone as a section mark.

assets.title: Gold acanthus divider terminal
assets.description: A painted divider terminal in textured gold with dark brown contours and pale cream highlights, a pointed acanthus leaf pointing left with a scroll curling up above it and one curling down below it, and a long straight gold stem extending to the right, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Terminal of a flexible divider with gold-lozenge-divider-center; the leaf points left and the stem runs right, so as drawn it closes the left end of a rule and is mirrored for the right end.
Draw the connecting rule at the height of the stem.

assets.title: Ivy corner, bottom-left
assets.description: A bottom-left corner in black penwork, drawn as two thin double rules meeting at the vertex under a cluster of curled acanthus leaves, with an ivy vine climbing the vertical rule and running along the horizontal one, pointed ivy leaves with veined interiors, curled tendrils and a curled leaf closing each end of the rules, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Place at the bottom-left of a page or box; the rules run along the two adjoining edges and close with curled leaves, not finials.
Use as a whole image; it is a separate drawing, not a rotation or mirror of the other three corners, and not a border-image atlas.
Open line art; the interiors of the leaves are transparent, so it reads best on a light ground.

assets.title: Ivy corner, bottom-right
assets.description: A bottom-right corner in black penwork, drawn as two thin double rules meeting at the vertex under a cluster of curled acanthus leaves, with an ivy vine climbing the vertical rule and running along the horizontal one, pointed ivy leaves with veined interiors, curled tendrils and a fleur-de-lis finial capping each end of the rules, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Place at the bottom-right of a page or box; the rules run along the two adjoining edges and end in finials, so they are not meant to be extended.
Use as a whole image; it is a separate drawing, not a rotation or mirror of the other three corners, and not a border-image atlas.
Open line art; the interiors of the leaves are transparent, so it reads best on a light ground.

assets.title: Ivy corner, top-left
assets.description: A top-left corner in black penwork, drawn as two thin double rules meeting at the vertex, with an ivy vine winding down the vertical rule and along the horizontal one, pointed three-lobed ivy leaves with veined interiors, small curled tendrils and a fleur-de-lis finial capping each end of the rules, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Place at the top-left of a page or box; the rules run along the two adjoining edges and end in finials, so they are not meant to be extended.
Use as a whole image; it is a separate drawing, not a rotation or mirror of the other three corners, and not a border-image atlas.
Open line art; the interiors of the leaves are transparent, so it reads best on a light ground.

assets.title: Ivy corner, top-right
assets.description: A top-right corner in black penwork, drawn as two thin double rules meeting at the vertex under a large curled acanthus leaf, with an ivy vine winding down the vertical rule and a shorter run of tendrils along the horizontal one, pointed ivy leaves with veined interiors, curled tendrils and a curled leaf closing each end of the rules, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Place at the top-right of a page or box; the rules run along the two adjoining edges and close with curled leaves, not finials.
Use as a whole image; it is a separate drawing, not a rotation or mirror of the other three corners, and not a border-image atlas.
Open line art; the interiors of the leaves are transparent, so it reads best on a light ground.

assets.title: Ivy fleuron
assets.description: A compact symmetric fleuron in black penwork, three pointed three-lobed ivy leaves on short stems that join at a single stalk below, the middle leaf upright and the outer two turned outward, with a heavy outer contour and fine veins inside, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Small standalone mark for a section break or a line end; the stalk at the bottom is where it meets a rule or baseline.
Open line art; the interiors of the leaves are transparent, so it reads best on a light ground.

assets.title: Ivy and flower divider
assets.description: A long horizontal divider in black penwork, a waving stem carrying pointed ivy leaves, three five-petalled flowers with hatched petals, two curling hatched acanthus leaves and small spiral tendrils, ending in an ivy leaf at the left and an ivy leaf with a tendril at the right, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete flourish with two different finished ends; use as a whole image, do not tile or stretch it.
Wide 6:1 piece; it sits as a section break or beneath a heading.
Open line art; the interiors of the leaves and petals are transparent, so it reads best on a light ground.

assets.title: Ivy line filler
assets.description: A slender horizontal line filler in black penwork, a gently waving stem with four pointed ivy leaves on short stalks, a five-petalled flower at the centre, small curled tendrils above and below the stem and a small lozenge terminal at each end, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete piece with finished lozenge ends; use as a whole image, do not tile or stretch it.
Thin and about 6:1; it sits between paragraphs or fills the end of a short line.

assets.title: Ruled ivy frame
assets.description: A complete landscape rectangular frame in black penwork, a thin double rule on all four sides with an ivy vine of pointed three-lobed leaves and curled tendrils running along the outside of the rules, curled acanthus leaves and small finials at the four corners and a small ivy spray at the middle of the top and bottom rules, around a transparent opening, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Fixed complete frame with a transparent centre; scale it proportionally as one image, its sides are not repeat tiles and it is not a border-image atlas.
Same double rule and ivy as the four separate ivy corners, which serve the same kit on pages of another proportion.
Open line art; the interiors of the leaves are transparent, so it reads best on a light ground.

assets.title: Ivy margin vine
assets.description: A tall narrow vertical vine in black penwork, a sinuous stem with alternating pointed ivy leaves and curled, hatched acanthus leaves to either side, small spiral tendrils along its length, a pointed ivy leaf as the top terminal and a curled leaf as the bottom terminal, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Standalone vertical margin ornament about 1:4; keep it upright and use it whole, it has no rule and no repeat unit.
Open line art; the interiors of the leaves are transparent, so it reads best on a light ground.

assets.title: Songbirds headpiece
assets.description: A wide symmetric headpiece in black penwork, two long-tailed songbirds perched on a branching stem and facing each other across a central upright ivy leaf, with solid black ivy leaves, curled tendrils and small berry clusters spreading to both sides, the birds and leaves drawn with transparent hatching, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Place above a title or at the head of a chapter; do not tile or stretch it.
Wide 3:1 piece; pairs with acanthus-tailpiece at the end of the text.
Heavier than the other penwork pieces, with solid black leaves; it holds up on darker grounds better than the open line art.

assets.title: Candelabrum carried by two blindfolded women
assets.description: A tall, narrow, symmetrical engraved candelabrum. At the top a winged putto stands on a leafy cushion with both arms raised, gripping the curled tips of two acanthus volutes. Below him a lobed cup, a gadrooned bowl and a baluster stem with a second small bowl, each stage flanked by mirrored acanthus scrolls and leaf sprays. At the base two nude blindfolded women kneel back to back with spiral volutes in place of arms and carry the shaft on their heads. Black ink line work on cream paper, background transparent.
usage_notes: Complete vertical ornament about six times taller than wide; it reads as a column or a page edge, not as a divider.
The date and monogram panel that sits below the two women in the print is not included.

assets.title: Frieze of four centaurs with riders
assets.description: A horizontal engraved frieze of four centaurs, two on each side, rearing toward the centre. The two inner centaurs, bearded and leaf-crowned, each carry a young rider and together grip a leafy spray that rises from a small bowl at the bottom centre; the two outer centaurs carry nude women who hold long feathery fronds arching over the ends. Trefoil sprigs and a low band of acanthus scrolls run between the hooves. Black ink line work on cream paper, no rules, background transparent.
usage_notes: Complete band about three times wider than tall; the fronds at both ends are its natural terminals, so no cropping is needed.

assets.title: Double cup with two putti
assets.description: A tall, symmetrical engraved double cup. A round foot and knopped stem carry a bulbous lower bowl, a wide band decorated with masks, lozenges and strapwork, and an inverted upper bowl topped by a small cup; thin leafy tendrils with two small birds rise from the sides and tasselled pendants hang at the left and right. At the base two winged putti sit on either side of the stem, each resting a hand on a blank strapwork cartouche. Black ink line work on cream paper, background transparent.
usage_notes: The two cartouches at the base are blank and small; the piece is a goldsmith's design, not a frame for text.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1919.19

assets.title: Coat of arms with horned helmet
assets.description: An engraved coat of arms. A tilted shield bears a diagonal band charged with three small shields. Above it a closed tilting helmet turned to the right carries a crest of two tall curved horns with trumpet-shaped ends. Leafy mantling hangs from knotted ties on each side of the helmet and curls down around the shield in scalloped acanthus fronds. Black ink line work on cream paper, background transparent.
usage_notes: The shield is tilted and the helmet faces right; mirror the whole piece for a left-facing use.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1915.1

assets.title: Bearded mask in a leaf scroll
assets.description: A horizontal, symmetrical engraved panel centred on a large frontal mask of a bearded man with an open mouth, small curled horns at the temples and a ribbed cap bound with a leaf garland; his beard flows down into leaf fronds. From the cap two long swags of overlapping leaves fall to either side, and thin stems with acanthus volutes, lobed leaves and small buds fill both halves. Halfway down each side a leafy beaked head bites a stem. Black ink line work on cream paper, background transparent.
usage_notes: Complete symmetrical panel; the mask reads from a distance, so it works as a headpiece above a title.

assets.title: Coat of arms with rampant lion and feather crest
assets.description: An engraved coat of arms. A tilted shield bears a rampant lion with a curled tail, facing left. Above it a closed tilting helmet turned to the right carries a tall crest of two fans of feathers rising from a twisted wreath. Plain cloth mantling with scalloped edges hangs in long folds on both sides of the helmet and tucks behind the shield. Black ink line work on cream paper, background transparent.
usage_notes: The lion faces left and the helmet right, so the piece has no single direction; mirroring it changes the lion's heraldic side.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1906.118

assets.title: Palmette between two dolphin heads
assets.description: A horizontal, symmetrical engraved panel. A large palmette fan rises from a small pedestal with two volutes at the bottom centre; below it two scaly dolphin heads with open toothed jaws face each other. To each side thin stems curl into acanthus volutes with lobed leaves, a trumpet-shaped horn, a round berry, a bud and a small flower head, ending in upright leaf clusters at the outer edges. Black ink line work on cream paper, background transparent.
usage_notes: Complete band; crop inside the outer leaf clusters when their cut edges would show against a plain ground.

assets.title: Coat of arms with rooster and banderoles
assets.description: An engraved coat of arms. A rounded shield bears a strutting rooster facing left on a stippled ground. Above it a closed tilting helmet turned to the left carries a coronet on which a crowned rooster stands between two curved horns, also facing left. Leafy acanthus mantling curls down both sides of the shield, and long blank banderoles loop above and beside the helmet. Black ink line work on cream paper, background transparent.
usage_notes: The banderoles are blank and narrow; they are decoration, not a text field.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg JB1891.590

assets.title: Square goldsmith's ornament with a central medallion
assets.description: A square, four-fold symmetrical ornament engraved as solid black shapes. A central medallion holds a rosette among fine leaf scrolls; a broad ring of dense black scrollwork encloses it, drawn out into a pointed lobe on each side, inside a thin ruled square whose spandrels hold four small animals, a long-tailed quadruped and three birds. Outside the square the ornament spreads as open scrollwork with large black flowers, tulip-shaped buds and rows of round berries, ending in sprays at the corners. Black ink on a transparent background; a faint film of paper tone remains over the square.
usage_notes: Near-square and symmetrical; it reads as a tailpiece, a tile centrepiece or a backing medallion.
The central medallion and the ruled inner square each crop out as a complete smaller ornament.
Black ink on light grounds only; on a dark page the ornament disappears and only the faint paper film shows.

assets.title: Apostle before a walled city, framed miniature
assets.description: The whole miniature from the leaf. A grey-haired, bearded apostle with a gold halo stands centred on a pale green ground facing the viewer, in a blue tunic and orange-brown mantle, right hand raised in speech and a rolled white scroll in his left. Pink and ochre city towers rise on either side with red cloth draped between them, on a burnished gold ground. A painted frame of a blue band with white curling vines between two narrow red and gold bands encloses the scene, with leaf flourishes at the four corners; it runs slightly askew. Opaque inside the frame, transparent outside.
usage_notes: Complete framed miniature with its own gold ground; place it as a picture, not as a cut-out.
The emptied frame is finite-blue-vine-and-red-gold-miniature-frame and the figure alone is standing-apostle-with-rolled-scroll.

assets.title: Blue vine miniature frame
assets.description: The painted frame of the miniature with its interior removed. A wide blue band carries a white curling vine with leaves and spiral tendrils, between a narrow outer and inner red band bearing a gold chain-like pattern, with a thin gold rule along the inside edge. Gold and red leaf finials spring outward from the two upper corners and blue, gold-edged leaf flourishes from the two lower corners. The frame is slightly trapezoidal as painted. Only the paint is opaque; the interior and everything outside the frame are transparent.
usage_notes: Fixed picture frame, scaled as a whole with content placed in its transparent interior; it is not a border-image because the top and right bands run askew and the four corner flourishes all differ.
For a band of the same ornament at any length use the two repeat tiles white-curling-vine-on-blue-repeat and gold-s-shaped-leaf-on-red-repeat.

assets.title: Gold S-leaf on red, repeat tile
assets.description: One cycle of the narrow red band of the miniature frame, a gold S-shaped leaf with a darker lobe painted on a dull red ground with gold speckling. The pattern continues across the left and right edges; the band's painted edges are slightly ragged and the thin strips above and below it are transparent.
usage_notes: Repeat along x; use the generated rotated tile for a vertical band. In the frame this band runs on both sides of the blue vine band.
Keep it at native size; the source band is only 70 px tall and blurs when enlarged.

assets.title: Haloed man facing left with open hand
assets.description: A small bearded man with a red-rimmed gold halo stands turned to the left with his head bowed, his right hand held out open towards the left, in a blue tunic under an orange mantle with white highlights, on a small red and gold base. The paint is worn, with pale parchment showing through the halo and face. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Pairs with haloed-man-gesturing-in-blue-and-green-robes, which faces right at the same scale; set them facing each other.

assets.title: Haloed man in profile pointing right
assets.description: A small bearded man with a gold halo stands in profile facing right, his right arm stretched out and pointing, in an olive-green tunic and a blue mantle wrapped around the lower body, on a small red and gold base. The paint is heavily flaked, with pale parchment showing through the halo, face and mantle. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Pairs with haloed-man-in-blue-and-orange-robes, which faces left at the same scale; set them facing each other.

assets.title: Standing apostle with a scroll
assets.description: A grey-haired, bearded apostle stands facing the viewer in a blue tunic and an orange-brown mantle with white highlights, draped over his left shoulder and wrapped around his body; his right hand is raised before his chest in a gesture of speech and his left holds a white rolled scroll. He wears sandals. His halo is kept as a thin gold ring with the gold ground inside it removed. Cut from the framed miniature of the leaf; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cut-out of the figure in complete-apostle-city-scene-with-blue-vine-frame; the halo is an open ring, so it reads best on a plain or gold background.

assets.title: White vine on blue, repeat tile
assets.description: One cycle of the blue band of the miniature frame. A white, grey-shaded vine stem curls into a spiral at the left, throws a three-lobed leaf upward at the centre and a hooked tendril downward, on a deep blue ground with dark speckling. The pattern continues across the left and right edges; the thin strips above and below the painted band are transparent.
usage_notes: Repeat along x; use the generated rotated tile for a vertical band. In the frame it is flanked by gold-s-shaped-leaf-on-red-repeat on both sides.
Keep it at or below native size; the source band is 111 px tall.

assets.title: Blue cornflower head
assets.description: A single blue cornflower seen from the front, its ragged fringed petals radiating in two layers around a dark navy centre with pale dots; the petals are mid blue with lighter streaks and a few white highlights at the tips. No stem or leaf; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cut from the bottom band of the strewn-flower border; the painted shadow on the gold ground is not included.
assets.attribution: Cleveland Museum of Art 1963.256.80.b; Hours of Queen Isabella, fol. 80v

assets.title: Crimson double rose head
assets.description: A dense double rose seen from the front, its many overlapping petals in deep pink shading to crimson at the folds, with fine darker hatching, around a slightly off-centre cluster of golden yellow stamens. No stem or leaf; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cut from the bottom band of the strewn-flower border; the painted shadow on the gold ground is not included.
assets.attribution: Cleveland Museum of Art 1963.256.80.b; Hours of Queen Isabella, fol. 80v

assets.title: Strewn-flower border with arched opening
assets.description: A complete page border on a textured gold ground with a tall round-arched transparent opening edged by a thin dark red rule; the left pillar is wide, the right one narrow, the bottom band widest and the top only a sliver above the arch. Scattered on the gold with painted shadows are pink wild roses, a crimson double rose, blue cornflowers and star flowers, pansies, pale lilac flowers, green buds, grey stems and curled silvery acanthus leaves, three butterflies (orange, grey, brown) and a small grey-brown bird with a blue wing patch at the lower left. The outside is transparent.
usage_notes: Fixed complete frame; place it as one image and put content inside the arched opening. The four sides are of different thickness and the opening is arched, so it is not a nine-slice border and has no frame atlas.
The five single flowers, butterflies and bird of this set are cut from this border and can be scattered around it in the same manner.
assets.attribution: Cleveland Museum of Art 1963.256.80.b; Hours of Queen Isabella, fol. 80v

assets.title: Grey butterfly in profile
assets.description: A grey butterfly seen from the side with its wings closed over its back, facing right. The pale grey-beige wings carry darker mottled bands and several black eyespots ringed in white, one large on the forewing and a row of smaller ones on the hindwing; the dark body, thin legs and two long clubbed antennae point to the right. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cut from the left pillar of the strewn-flower border; the painted shadow on the gold ground is not included.
assets.attribution: Cleveland Museum of Art 1963.256.80.b; Hours of Queen Isabella, fol. 80v

assets.title: Orange butterfly in profile
assets.description: A small butterfly seen from the side with its wings closed over its back, facing right. The forewing is orange with brown mottling and black eyespots ringed in yellow; the larger hindwing below is pale grey with a row of black eyespots ringed in white. The dark body, thin legs and two clubbed antennae point to the right. The background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cut from the top left corner of the strewn-flower border; the painted shadow on the gold ground is not included.
assets.attribution: Cleveland Museum of Art 1963.256.80.b; Hours of Queen Isabella, fol. 80v

assets.title: Small bird with blue wing patch
assets.description: A small songbird standing in profile and facing left, with a grey-brown head and back, a dark pointed beak, a round dark eye, a cream breast streaked with brown, a bright blue patch on the folded wing, a short barred tail and two thin dark legs with spread claws. There is no ground under the feet; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cut from the lower left of the strewn-flower border; the painted shadow on the gold ground is not included. The feet rest on nothing, so give it a baseline or let it perch on an edge.
assets.attribution: Cleveland Museum of Art 1963.256.80.b; Hours of Queen Isabella, fol. 80v

assets.title: Frieze of Cupid subduing two lions in acanthus scrolls
assets.description: A long horizontal etched frieze. At the centre a winged Cupid, seen from the front with his head bowed, grips the manes of two lions that crouch to either side of him; the lions' hindquarters dissolve into large acanthus volutes that curl outward, and a further volute closes each end, the left one wrapping a cluster of berries. At the far left and far right a fragment of a neighbouring shaggy lion's head, cut by the plate edge, is included. Loose dark brown ink line work; the faint paper tone of the plate area is kept at low opacity.
usage_notes: Symmetrical about Cupid, so it sits well centred under a title; crop about 4 percent off each end to drop the cut lion-head fragments.
Pairs with the heads-of-the-seasons frieze from the same plate, which has the same height and ink.

assets.title: Frieze of four heads of the seasons in acanthus
assets.description: A long horizontal etched frieze of linked acanthus scrolls carrying four heads. From the left, a bearded old man's head facing right under a leafy wreath; a blank cartouche of knotted branches; a young woman's head facing left crowned with flowers; a central burst of large feathery acanthus leaves; a girl's head facing right with ears of grain in her hair; a round wreath of wheat and grapes enclosing a hanging pair of scales; and a youth's head facing left wreathed in vine at the right end. Loose dark brown ink; the faint paper tone of the plate is kept at low opacity.
usage_notes: The blank branch cartouche at the left and the wreath at the right are open fields that can carry a short word or number.
Each head with its scroll crops out as a small vignette; the central leaf burst crops as a symmetrical centrepiece.
Pairs with the Cupid-and-lions frieze from the same plate, which has the same ink and a slightly greater height.

assets.title: Abrotonum foemina, upright flowering stem
assets.description: A single tall upright stem rises from a short, many-branched root at the bottom; its lower half is bare and its upper half carries a narrow plume of side branches with finely divided leaves and small round button-like flower heads at the tips. Dark brown-black woodcut line work with no ground line, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Ink-only extraction, the lines are one dark brown-black and the alpha carries the ink density, so it sits on any light ground; on a dark ground it needs recolouring.
Very tall and narrow (about 1:2.9); suits a margin or the side of a text column.
assets.attribution: Universitätsbibliothek Basel UBH Lo I 4; scan [39]; image 543716

assets.title: Alsine media, chickweed tuft
assets.description: Common chickweed (Stellaria media), a loose sprawling tuft of thin trailing stems that spread upward and outward from a small fibrous root at the bottom centre, set with pairs of small toothed oval leaves and tiny five-petalled flowers and buds at the tips; the tuft is wider at the top than at the root. Dark brown-black woodcut line work with no ground line, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Ink-only extraction, the lines are one dark brown-black and the alpha carries the ink density, so it sits on any light ground; on a dark ground it needs recolouring.
The upper two thirds crop to a loose scatter of leafy stems without the root.
assets.attribution: Universitätsbibliothek Basel UBH Lo I 4; scan [54]; image 543731

assets.title: Anagallis mas, pimpernel sprig
assets.description: Scarlet pimpernel (Anagallis mas, the red-flowered pimpernel), a trailing plant whose thin stems arch up and outward from a fibrous root at the lower left, carrying pairs of pointed oval leaves, open five-petalled flowers and many round buds and seed capsules on short stalks; the arching stems leave open space in the middle. Dark brown-black woodcut line work with no ground line, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Ink-only extraction, the lines are one dark brown-black and the alpha carries the ink density, so it sits on any light ground; on a dark ground it needs recolouring.
Nearly square, with the root tucked in the lower left; crops well to the upper arch of stems and flowers.
assets.attribution: Universitätsbibliothek Basel UBH Lo I 4; scan [50]; image 543727

assets.title: Chamaemelum eranthemon, flowering branch
assets.description: An upright branching plant with a long slender root that takes up the lower third, whorls of narrow linear leaves along the thin stems, and about a dozen five-petalled flowers with hanging, parted petals at the branch tips; the crown spreads wider than the stem below it. Dark brown-black woodcut line work with no ground line, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Ink-only extraction, the lines are one dark brown-black and the alpha carries the ink density, so it sits on any light ground; on a dark ground it needs recolouring.
The long bare root can be cropped at the stem base for a shorter, airier piece.
assets.attribution: Universitätsbibliothek Basel UBH Lo I 4; scan [59]; image 543736

assets.title: Plantago maior, greater plantain
assets.description: Greater plantain (Plantago major), a rosette of six broad ribbed oval leaves on long stalks spreading left and right from a tangle of fibrous roots at the centre, with three tall narrow flower spikes rising from the middle; one leaf hangs down below the root. Dark brown-black woodcut line work with no ground line, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Ink-only extraction, the lines are one dark brown-black and the alpha carries the ink density, so it sits on any light ground; on a dark ground it needs recolouring.
The lowest leaf hangs below the root; crop it off at the root for a compact rosette with the spikes.
assets.attribution: Universitätsbibliothek Basel UBH Lo I 4; scan [69]; image 543746

assets.title: Sedum maius, houseleek in flower
assets.description: Common houseleek (Sempervivum tectorum), a rosette of fleshy pointed leaves at the base over a thick root and trailing runners, from which a tall column-like stem densely clad in overlapping leaves rises and opens at the top into a crown of curled, spreading branches bearing many small star-shaped flowers; the whole reads as a symmetrical upright emblem. Dark brown-black woodcut line work with no ground line, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Ink-only extraction, the lines are one dark brown-black and the alpha carries the ink density, so it sits on any light ground; on a dark ground it needs recolouring.
Keep root, rosette and flower crown together; the piece is built as one vertical emblem.
assets.attribution: Universitätsbibliothek Basel UBH Lo I 4; scan [64]; image 543741

assets.title: Seriphium absinthium, wormwood bush
assets.description: A wormwood (Artemisia), three tall upright shoots rising from a thick twisted root at the lower right, each densely set from base to tip with finely divided feathery leaves; the shoots lean slightly apart and fill a tall rectangle with little open space. Dark brown-black woodcut line work with no ground line, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Ink-only extraction, the lines are one dark brown-black and the alpha carries the ink density, so it sits on any light ground; on a dark ground it needs recolouring.
Dense foliage; reads as a textured block beside text rather than as a silhouette.
assets.attribution: Universitätsbibliothek Basel UBH Lo I 4; scan [34]; image 543711

assets.title: Armoured rhinoceros
assets.description: A rhinoceros walking to the left in profile, its body covered in plated armour with scalloped edges, mail-like hatching on the legs, a single horn on the nose and a small twisted horn on the shoulder, after Dürer's 1515 woodcut. Black woodcut line on the beige paper tone of the page, which is kept inside the outline; the background outside the figure is transparent.
usage_notes: The paper tone inside the figure is kept, so it reads as a cut-out of the printed page; place it on a light or mid-toned ground.
assets.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 627406; section De rhinocerote.

assets.title: Beaver
assets.description: A beaver walking to the right in profile with its mouth open to show the long incisors, dense hatched fur, clawed feet and the flat scaly paddle tail trailing to the left. Black woodcut line on the beige paper tone of the page, which is kept inside the outline; the background outside the figure is transparent.
usage_notes: The paper tone inside the figure is kept, so it reads as a cut-out of the printed page; place it on a light or mid-toned ground.
Wide strip (about 2.5:1) that works as a footer or title band.
assets.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 626789; section De castore.

assets.title: Seated tabby cat
assets.description: A tabby cat sitting upright and looking straight at the viewer, with pointed ears, long whiskers, banded stripes across the chest and flanks and the tail curled around the front paws. Black woodcut line on the beige paper tone of the page, which is kept inside the outline; the background outside the figure is transparent.
usage_notes: The paper tone inside the figure is kept, so it reads as a cut-out of the printed page; place it on a light or mid-toned ground.
assets.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 626798; section De cato seu fele.

assets.title: Crocodile
assets.description: A crocodile seen from above and slightly from the side, its head at the left with the jaws wide open to show rows of teeth, four splayed legs, a back of square plates and a long ringed tail curling up to the right. Black woodcut line on the beige paper tone of the page, which is kept inside the outline; the background outside the figure is transparent.
usage_notes: The paper tone inside the figure is kept, so it reads as a cut-out of the printed page; place it on a light or mid-toned ground.
Wide strip (about 2.4:1) that works as a footer or title band.
assets.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 2119273; section De crocodilo.

assets.title: Elephant
assets.description: An elephant walking to the right in profile, with a large fan-shaped ear, two tusks, the trunk curling down and inward, columnar legs on flat round feet and a thin tufted tail. Black woodcut line on the beige paper tone of the page, which is kept inside the outline; the background outside the figure is transparent.
usage_notes: The paper tone inside the figure is kept, so it reads as a cut-out of the printed page; place it on a light or mid-toned ground.
assets.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 626863; section De elephanto.

assets.title: Elk antler
assets.description: A single palmated antler of a European elk (moose) standing upright, the broad veined palm rising from a knobbed burr at the lower right and ending in a row of pointed tines along the left edge and across the top. Black woodcut line on the beige paper tone of the page, which is kept inside the outline; the background outside the antler is transparent.
usage_notes: The paper tone inside the antler is kept, so it reads as a cut-out of the printed page; place it on a light or mid-toned ground.
Tall upright piece (about 3:5); pairs with a mirrored copy as a symmetrical ornament.
assets.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 626455; section De alce.

assets.title: Seated fox
assets.description: A fox sitting on its haunches and facing right, with pointed ears, a narrow whiskered muzzle, shaggy hatched fur and a long bushy tail stretched out along the ground to the left. Black woodcut line on the beige paper tone of the page, which is kept inside the outline; the background outside the figure is transparent.
usage_notes: The paper tone inside the figure is kept, so it reads as a cut-out of the printed page; place it on a light or mid-toned ground.
assets.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 627534; section De vulpe.

assets.title: Grape bunch with branch stub
assets.description: A tiny bunch of grapes hanging below two broad vine leaves, the stem ending at the top in a short horizontal stub of the branch it grew from, taken from the decorated initial L of the lion chapter. Dark brown printed ink only, a few dozen pixels across; the paper is removed and the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Render at or below the master's pixel size; it blurs when enlarged.
Ink only, so it sits on any ground; the branch stub closes the piece, so it stands alone better than the cropped variant.
assets.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 627095; section De leone.

assets.title: Standing horse
assets.description: A stallion standing in profile and facing left, with a short upright mane, a long flowing tail reaching the ground and one hind leg raised. Black woodcut line on the beige paper tone of the page, which is kept inside the outline; the background outside the figure is transparent.
usage_notes: The paper tone inside the figure is kept, so it reads as a cut-out of the printed page; place it on a light or mid-toned ground.
assets.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 626896; section De equo.

assets.title: Walking lion
assets.description: A maned lion walking to the left in profile, with a heavy shaggy mane falling over the shoulders and chest, large paws and a thin tail raised behind and ending in a tuft. Black woodcut line on the beige paper tone of the page, which is kept inside the outline; the background outside the figure is transparent.
usage_notes: The paper tone inside the figure is kept, so it reads as a cut-out of the printed page; place it on a light or mid-toned ground.
Wide strip (about 2:1) that works as a footer or title band.
assets.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 627095; section De leone.

assets.title: Pear with curved stalk
assets.description: A tiny pear hanging from a stem that continues upward into a short curve ending in a knob where the stalk joined the branch, taken from the decorated initial L of the lion chapter. Dark brown printed ink only, a few dozen pixels across; the paper is removed and the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Render at or below the master's pixel size; it blurs when enlarged.
Ink only, so it sits on any ground; the curved stalk closes the piece, so it stands alone better than the cropped variant.
assets.attribution: Zentralbibliothek Zürich 5.1: a-5.3; image 627095; section De leone.

assets.title: Closed rosebud on its stem
assets.description: A closed pink rosebud hangs with its tip toward the lower left, the folded petals wrapped by five long olive-green sepals that splay out in thin curving points, with a hairy green hip and a short thorny stem that rises to the upper right. Finely hatched watercolour and gouache on a transparent background, no ground.
usage_notes: The more open bud hoefnagel-rose-upper comes from the same plant on the folio; the two hang well one above the other with their stems to the right.
The stem is short and ends cleanly at the upper right, so the piece needs no cropping.
assets.attribution: J. Paul Getty Museum Ms. 20 (86.MV.527), fol. 107

assets.title: Apple cut in half
assets.description: A red apple cut in two, the halves lying with their pale cream cut faces toward the viewer and overlapping, the left half slightly behind the right; each cut face shows a yellow-brown core cavity with one dark brown seed, the left half carries the short brown stalk at the top and both halves keep a dried brown blossom end on the red skin. Finely hatched gouache and watercolour on a transparent background, no ground.
usage_notes: The lowest curve of the skin is cut flat by the canvas edge; rest that edge on a baseline, rule or page bottom and the cut disappears.
assets.attribution: J. Paul Getty Museum Ms. 20 (86.MV.527), fol. 107

assets.title: Opening rosebud on a long stem
assets.description: A half-open pink rosebud at the left, its outer petals loosening and shaded from pale pink to deep rose, held by olive-green sepals that curl back along the bud and over the hairy hip; a long thin green stem runs almost horizontally to the right edge. Finely hatched watercolour and gouache on a transparent background, no ground.
usage_notes: The closed bud hoefnagel-rose-lower comes from the same plant on the folio; the two hang well one above the other with their stems to the right.
Wide piece (about 2.3:1); the long stem at the right can be cropped or run under a line of text without losing the flower.
assets.attribution: J. Paul Getty Museum Ms. 20 (86.MV.527), fol. 107

assets.title: Strapwork cartouche frame
assets.description: A complete landscape rectangular cartouche frame of interlaced cream strapwork, the bands curling into scrolls and cut-leather tabs over a dark hatched ground, with a small rosette at each corner, a fleur-de-lis style finial at the middle of every side and a thin double rule around the transparent rectangular opening; fine golden-brown leafy vine tendrils spread outward from the whole outer edge. Pen and ink in brown and black on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete frame; scale proportionally as one image, it has no tile and is not sliced for border-image.
The opening is the central rectangle inside the double rule; keep content clear of the hatched inner band.
assets.attribution: J. Paul Getty Museum Ms. 20 (86.MV.527), fol. 107

assets.title: Title cartouche with horned hybrids and bears
assets.description: A wide, symmetrical etched cartouche frieze. The centre is an open blank field bounded by leafy scrolls, with a bearded mask at the top and a knot of leaves at the bottom. To each side a horned, winged female hybrid whose lower body turns into acanthus scroll leans toward the field, a cluster of grapes hanging beside her; at either end a bear bites the scaly dragon-headed terminal of the outer volute, and the frieze ends in fish-scaled curls. Dark brown ink on a transparent background; the faint paper tone of the plate is kept at low opacity, and the title lettering in the field was removed.
usage_notes: The open centre field is a title plaque about a third of the width wide; set a line of text in it.
Symmetrical about the field; either half with its bear crops out as an end ornament.

assets.title: Frieze with two winged bearded masks
assets.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. At the left end a round bearded mask with feathered wings behind it faces left; at the right end a second winged bearded mask faces right. Between them run two large curled acanthus volutes, a folded leaf cup at the centre and two trumpet-shaped bell flowers hanging on stalks, all joined by one stem. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the masks and scroll alone.
Both ends terminate in a mask, so it does not repeat; use it once as a header or footer band.

assets.title: Grapevine frieze with central knot
assets.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. A single vine stem runs the whole length and is knotted into a loop at the centre; along it hang four large lobed vine leaves, two bunches of grapes (one left of centre, one right of centre) and curling tendrils with small buds. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the vine alone.
The only frieze of the sheet without a creature; the plainest choice for a text divider.

assets.title: Frieze of a horned dragon with a flowering tail
assets.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. A dragon fills the left half, facing left with open jaws, a long forked tongue, a curled horn and a small budding sprig in front of its snout; its feathered body has a raised wing and two clawed feet. Its tail flows right into a foliate scroll of acanthus volutes and leaf sprays ending in a small bud at the right end. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the dragon and scroll alone.
The dragon faces left; mirror the band for a right-facing use.

assets.title: Frieze with back-to-back bearded heads
assets.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. At the centre two bearded male heads in profile sit back to back, the left one facing left and the right one facing right; each beard flows into a trumpet-shaped horn. Vine stems with trefoil leaves and clover-like leaflets curl out from the heads to a five-petalled flower at each end. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the heads and scroll alone.
Symmetrical about the paired heads, so it sits well centred under a title.

assets.title: Frieze with two horned dragons and twin flowers
assets.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. Two scaly winged dragons with long curled horns and open mouths lie at the ends, the left one facing left and the right one facing right; their tails curl inward into scrolls that each hold a five-petalled flower, and a fleur-de-lis-shaped tie joins the two scrolls at the centre. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the dragons and flowers alone.
Symmetrical about the central tie, so it sits well centred under a title.

assets.title: Frieze with two human-headed winged creatures
assets.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. Two winged creatures with curly-haired human heads, feathered bodies, clawed legs and long scaly tails lie at the ends, the left one facing left and the right one facing right. Their tails loop toward the centre, where two small crested dragon heads face a knotted tie topped by a fleur-de-lis. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the creatures alone.
Symmetrical about the central tie, so it sits well centred under a title.

assets.title: Frieze with two winged beasts and a central face
assets.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. A frontal human face with leafy hair sits at the centre between two feathered volutes. On each side a lean horned, dog-like winged beast runs outward, the left one facing left and the right one facing right with open mouth, and a small leafy sprig grows between each beast and the face. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the beasts and face alone.
Symmetrical about the central face, so it sits well centred under a title.

assets.title: Frieze with two winged putti holding a bowl
assets.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. Two winged putti face each other at the centre and together hold a shallow bowl from which leaves sprout; their lower bodies turn into feathered, scaly scrolls that run outward to the ends, where they finish in curled acanthus leaves, a tendril with buds at the left and a leafy terminal at the right. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the putti and scroll alone.
Symmetrical about the bowl, so it sits well centred under a title.

assets.title: Frieze of a scroll ending in a horned bearded head
assets.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. From a lobed leaf with berried tendrils at the left, a stem curls through acanthus volutes and a looped, scalloped feathered stem into a hairy winged creature whose body fills the right half; its long-bearded head with a curled horn is at the right end, facing right with open mouth. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the scroll alone.
Reads from the leaf at the left to the head at the right; mirror it for a left-pointing use.

assets.title: Candelabra grotesque with two satyrs
assets.description: A tall, narrow, symmetrical etched candelabrum seen frontally. From the bottom up, a stepped plinth carries an acanthus base with two bearded masks, a blank tablet, two winged dolphins, a fluted basin, two standing satyrs each raising a flaming cup with a bird-headed grotesque at either side, a second basin, two crouching bat-winged grotesques, two more dolphins, a plumed stem, a small nude figure between two balusters, and a crossbar hung with swags and flaming torches. Brownish-grey ink line work on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Very tall piece (about 1 to 3.5); it suits a page margin, a column or a vertical separator at full height.
The blank tablet above the base can carry a short caption.

assets.title: Thistle panel with birds
assets.description: An upright rectangular etched panel inside a thin black frame line. Thick, white thistle stems with spiked lobed leaves and small thistle heads curl and interlace over a dark cross-hatched ground; a bird holding a sprig flies in at the top left, a crane-like bird stands at the top right, a third bird perches at the lower left, and a few open five-petalled flowers fill the corners. The monogram DH is cut into the stem at the bottom centre. Black, grey and white; the panel is opaque with its ground kept, and only the margin outside the frame line is transparent.
usage_notes: Opaque panel with its original hatched ground and frame line; place it as a picture or plate, not as a cut-out.
The DH monogram at the bottom centre is part of the print and should stay visible.

assets.title: Frieze of a winged putto with a shield and braided scroll
assets.description: A horizontal etched frieze between double rules. A winged putto lies at the left end facing left and holds up an empty curved-top shield; its lower body turns into two intertwined, braided stems that run to the right through a leafy calyx flower and finish at the right end in a fanned leaf terminal with a small spiral. Dark brown ink line work on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Complete band; the double rules above and below are part of the print, so crop inside them to use the putto and scroll alone.
The shield at the left is blank and can carry a small monogram or device.

assets.title: Divider centrepiece

assets.title: Polyhymnia playing a portative organ
assets.description: The muse Polyhymnia, a veiled young woman in a cream gown, pink sleeves and a blue mantle, sits on a stone bench and plays a portative organ, head bowed and turned to the right, before a garden and a hilly landscape with a castle. The arched scene is set in an opaque gold border strewn with pink roses, blue cornflowers, pansies, white acanthus sprays, butterflies and a bird; only the outer edge is transparent.
usage_notes: Complete framed miniature for the Polyhymnia app; the painted border is part of the image, keep proportions.

assets.title: Title ivy, closing sprig

usage_notes: Place before the first letter of a heading; the matching closing sprig goes after the last letter.
Cut from the left half of the original two-piece canvas; the two pieces were drawn together and share scale and baseline.

assets.title: Vertical margin sprig
assets.description: A slender upright sprig on a gold stem: a blue acanthus leaf curling to the right near the top, a red leaf curling to the left below it, three green ivy leaves, a red bud at the top and a curled gold root at the bottom, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Standalone vertical margin ornament; keep it upright, it has no rule or repeat unit.

assets.title: Two linked medallions with winged children on clouds
assets.description: Two engraved circular medallion rings joined side by side by a leaf clasp, each tied with a leaf knot at top and bottom. In the left ring a naked winged putto sits on clouds facing right with a flaming torch and a bow, a quiver beside him; in the right ring a robed winged child sits on clouds facing left, one arm outstretched, holding a tall cross on a staff. Acanthus tendrils spring from the four corners and two small serpent-like creatures curl under the rings. Black ink with hatched shading; the cream paper tone is kept inside the forms, the field inside and around the rings is transparent.
usage_notes: Complete piece; the two children are also available on their own without the rings, as separate assets of this set.
Wide (about 1.6:1); it reads as a headpiece or a paired-roundel ornament.

assets.title: Winged child with torch and bow on clouds
assets.description: A naked winged putto sits on a rounded bank of clouds, body turned three-quarter to the viewer and head turned to the right. His raised left hand holds a flaming torch, his right hand holds a bow across his lap, a tubular quiver on a strap lies beside his right leg and a globe rests in the clouds at the lower left. Black ink with hatched shading; the cream paper tone is kept inside the figure and clouds, and the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cut from the left medallion of the double-medallion ornament; the clouds give it a soft rounded base, so it sits on a line or in a roundel.
Faces right; pairs with the cross-bearing child, which faces left.

assets.title: Winged child with a cross on clouds
assets.description: A winged child in a loose robe sits on a bank of clouds, seen three-quarter from behind and facing left. The left arm stretches straight out to the left across the face, the right hand holds a tall thin cross on a staff that leans to the upper left, and one bare foot rests on the cloud below. Black ink with hatched shading; the cream paper tone is kept inside the figure, robe and clouds, and the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Cut from the right medallion of the double-medallion ornament; the clouds give it a soft rounded base, so it sits on a line or in a roundel.
Faces left; pairs with the torch-and-bow child, which faces right.

assets.title: Oak leaf corner with a long stem and acorn
assets.description: An L-shaped engraved ornament for a top-right corner. A dense mass of large, deeply lobed oak leaves, folded and interlaced with looping ribbon-like stems, fills the top-left arm; from the vertex at the top right a long curling stem descends the right side, throwing off smaller lobed leaves and curls, and ends at the bottom in a single acorn in its scaly cup. Black ink with fine hatched shading; the pale grey-cream paper tone is kept inside the leaves and stems, and the background is transparent.
usage_notes: Fits a top-right corner as engraved (leaves along the top, stem down the right side); mirror or rotate it for the other corners.
The leaf mass alone crops out as a square ornament, and the stem with the acorn as a vertical sprig.

assets.title: Acanthus panel with two lovers
assets.description: A large horizontal engraved panel filled edge to edge with curling acanthus stems and lobed leaves. At the top centre a seated couple, a woman in a tall hennin with a small dog on her lap and a young man in a cap, under a banderole inscribed with the artist's name. Among the scrolls are two birds at the top corners, nude figures climbing and riding the stems, a bearded man with a spear at the right, a youth rising from a tuft of grass at the bottom, a fox at the lower left, a man raising a cup at the lower right and two hanging pod finials. Dark brown ink on cream, background transparent.
usage_notes: Complete panel with no frame line; its outer leaves are the natural edge, so it can sit directly on a page.
The signature banderole above the couple is part of the print and should stay visible.

assets.title: Tree of Jesse in an acanthus scroll
assets.description: A wide horizontal engraved panel. The bearded Jesse lies asleep at the bottom centre, and from his body a stem rises and branches into curling acanthus scrolls that carry twelve crowned kings in long robes, seated, kneeling or climbing in the loops of the stems; one at the right of centre plays a harp, others hold an orb, a book or flower heads. At the top centre the crowned Virgin sits with the Child on her lap. Dark brown ink line work on cream paper, no frame line, background transparent.
usage_notes: Complete panel; Jesse and the rising stem are the centre of the composition, so keep the whole width or crop symmetrically.

assets.title: Circular acanthus wreath
assets.description: A ring-shaped engraved wreath of curling acanthus stems and lobed leaves around an open circular centre. Two thick stems run around the inside of the ring and are bound together at the top and at the bottom. Flower heads, buds, a netted fruit at the lower right and a large blossom at the right sit among the scrolls, which end in small leaf tips around the outer edge. No figures or masks. Dark brown ink line work on cream paper; the centre and the background are transparent.
usage_notes: The open centre is about half the diameter of the ring; in the print it holds the two musicians at the well, so place that scene or a roundel of similar size inside it.
A circular ring, not a nine-slice frame; it is placed as an image, not as a CSS border-image.

assets.title: Two musicians at a well
assets.description: An engraved scene of two musicians seated on stone blocks on either side of an octagonal well. At the left a barefoot young man with curly hair in a short tunic plays a lute with a plectrum, facing right; at the right a woman in a long gown with long hair plays a harp, facing left. Between them a small Gothic canopy on four posts with a cross finial and a perched bird rises over the water, a vessel hangs from a tripod above it, a bird drinks at the rim, and two potted trees stand behind. Dark brown ink line work on cream paper, background transparent.
usage_notes: The centre of the same print; it fits inside the open ring of the circular wreath at about half the wreath's width.

assets.title: Two añafil players in a framed miniature
assets.description: Two seated musicians in red and purple robes, on gold chairs inside a blue framed miniature, blow long straight gold trumpets (añafiles) hung with heraldic pennants; they face left. The frame and blue ground are part of the image; only the area outside the frame is transparent.
usage_notes: Complete framed miniature with its own blue background; place it as a picture, not as a cut-out.
Origin unrecorded; attribution to adrian729. Removed on any rights claim.

assets.title: Cattle singing at a music stand
assets.description: Three oxen and a small sheep stand on a strip of green ground and face left toward a wooden music stand holding an open score, while two small birds fly above at the right; coloured print-like line work on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Wide strip (about 3:1) that works as a footer or title band.
Origin unrecorded; attribution to adrian729. Removed on any rights claim.

assets.title: Animal musicians in a framed miniature

Fully opaque, with pink and green border columns; nothing is transparent.
usage_notes: Complete opaque scene including its patterned ground and borders; place it as a picture, not as a cut-out.
Small master (720 px wide); do not display it larger than its pixel size.
