assets.title: Rosselli vertical foliate ornament
assets.description: The complete engraved vertical ornament from the left of the sheet, about five times taller than wide. A central stem carries three lily-like palmettes on banded knots, flanked at every level by mirrored acanthus leaves that curl outward into C-scrolls and small berry sprigs; a small finial closes the top and the lowest leaves close the bottom. Dark brown engraved lines over cream and tan interiors, the openings between the leaves and the surrounding sheet transparent.
usage_notes: Whole strip with its original end terminals; it does not repeat, so use rosselli-foliate-border for a tiled run.
The sheet pairs it as the vertical side of a page frame with the mask frieze running horizontally and a roundel in each corner.

assets.title: Rosselli foliate border, one repeat
assets.description: One repeat of the engraved vertical foliate ornament, cut so the top and bottom edges join seamlessly when stacked. A central lily-like palmette on a banded stem is flanked by mirrored acanthus leaves that curl outward into C-scrolls, with small berry sprigs at the two sides; dark brown engraved lines over cream and tan interiors, the openings between the leaves and the surrounding sheet transparent.
usage_notes: Cropped from rosselli-foliate-strip at one repeat (438 px of the 1400 px strip); interior pixels are unchanged and only a two-pixel collar at the join is averaged.
Repeats along its length; the build's rotated ladder gives the horizontal use.
The frame atlas composes this repeat with the corner component; use it with border-image and round fitting. The corner is not a recovered historical motif.

assets.title: Rosselli mask frieze
assets.description: The complete engraved frieze from the right of the sheet, about five times longer than wide, stored upright as on the sheet so the masks lie on their side. Along its length four bearded masks in beaded crowns with plumes of acanthus leaves alternate with heart-shaped foliate cartouches and scrolling leaves, a fifth mask is cut off at the top end, and a chain of small rosettes runs along the right edge; both ends stop on cut foliage. Dark brown engraved lines over cream and tan interiors, the openings and the surrounding sheet transparent.
usage_notes: The frieze is horizontal by design; rotate it 90 degrees clockwise to bring the masks upright with the rosette chain at the bottom edge.
Whole strip; its ends are not a seamless join, so use rosselli-mask-border for a tiled run.
The sheet pairs it as the horizontal side of a page frame with the vertical foliate ornament and a roundel in each corner.

assets.title: Rosselli mask frieze, one repeat
assets.description: One repeat of the engraved frieze of masks and foliage, cut so the ends join seamlessly when stacked. A bearded mask in a beaded crown with a plume of acanthus leaves fills the lower half and a heart-shaped foliate cartouche with scrolling leaves the upper half, with a chain of small rosettes along the right edge; dark brown engraved lines over cream and tan interiors, the openings and the surrounding sheet transparent. Stored upright as on the sheet, so the masks lie on their side; the frieze reads upright when run horizontally.
usage_notes: Cropped from rosselli-mask-strip at one repeat (290 px of the 1400 px strip); interior pixels are unchanged and only a two-pixel collar at the join is averaged.
The repeat is barely longer than it is thick, so it is not declared as a tile; repeat it with background-repeat along the master's height, or use rosselli-mask-strip for a long run.
The frame atlas composes this repeat with the corner component; use it with border-image and round fitting. The corner is not a recovered historical motif.

assets.title: Rosselli roundel, palmettes and inner ring
assets.description: The engraved roundel from the lowest of the sheet's four square corner panels, cut to the circle without the panel's ruled square. Inside an egg-and-dart rim a central rosette sits in a fluted boss ringed by a second thin circle; acanthus palmettes with a bud reach out to the four cardinal points, and shell fans with small scrolling leaves fill the four diagonals; dark brown engraved lines over cream and tan interiors, the openings and the surrounding sheet transparent.
usage_notes: One of the four corner roundels of the sheet's page-frame scheme; the four are interchangeable and read as a set at the corners of a frame made from the two strips.
Closest to rosselli-roundel-top, which lacks the inner ring.

assets.title: Trophy of crossed weapons
assets.description: A hanging trophy of arms engraved in brown line on a transparent background, the paper tone kept inside the outlines. A long bow curves across the bundle from upper left to lower right, several slender shafts and a hilted sword cross behind it, and a short tubular case points down at the bottom; the pieces are bound together at the centre. It was cut from the lower left of the letter B sheet, where it hung from the letter's strapwork by a cord with a tassel.
usage_notes: On the sheet this hangs at the lower left and the foliate trophy at the lower right; the two work as a matched pair flanking a title or a rule.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1913.136

assets.title: Bouquet of flowers and buds

The vase that held it on the letter B sheet is excluded, so the stems end in a cut at the lower edge.
usage_notes: The stems are cut flat at the bottom where the vase began; set the bouquet into a vase, a cup or behind a rule rather than leaving the cut visible.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1913.136

assets.title: Foliate trophy tied with a ribbon

assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1913.136

assets.title: Hanging fruit with gourd pendant
assets.description: A hanging cluster of fruit engraved in brown line on a transparent background. A large round fruit at the upper left sits among a bunch of small round berries and short leaves, and a long smooth teardrop-shaped gourd hangs from it down the lower right, narrowing to a stalk at the top. On the letter B sheet this cluster hung from a hook at the upper left of the letter's strapwork.

assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1913.136

assets.title: Winged putto holding a strap end
assets.description: A curly-haired winged putto sits facing the viewer with a cloth across his lap, his right arm stretched out to the left and his left hand raised to grip the curling end of a strapwork band at the upper right, which ends in a small animal head and has a flower-shaped pendant hanging from it; a small bud and leaf hang below his right hand. usage_notes: The strap end with the animal head is part of the letter's frame and is kept so the raised hand holds something; crop it at the wrist if only the figure is needed.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1913.136

assets.title: Seated man pulling a cord

assets.title: Curling leaf ornament on a long stem
assets.description: A tall foliate ornament of broad lobed leaves that curl into two spirals, one at the top left and one at the top right, with smaller curled leaves sprouting between them; a long thin stem sweeps down from the foliage to the lower right and a short forked twig branches off it toward the lower left. assets.title: Curling thistle ornament
assets.description: A tall thistle ornament in which a thick stem rises from a short rooted base at the bottom right, curves up and to the left, and breaks into spiky, deeply cut thistle leaves that spread in a loose crown across the top; smaller spiky leaf sprays grow from the stem at the right and at the lower left. usage_notes: Stands upright on its rooted base; works as a tall side ornament or a tailpiece.

assets.title: Hop vine and leaf scroll panel
assets.description: A wide rectangular panel filled edge to edge with foliage, broad curling lobed leaves on thick stems interwoven with a thinner hop vine that carries serrated leaves and hanging hop cones, the thick stems looping into a large ring at the centre; a thin engraved plate rule runs along all four sides. Engraved in dark brown line only, with the ground showing through between the hatch lines, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Line work only; the ink is partial alpha and the page shows between the lines, so it reads best on light or cream grounds.
The thin plate rule on all four sides is part of the master; crop just inside it for a borderless panel.

assets.title: Crested bird flying right

assets.title: Owl mocked by day birds in a leafy scroll
assets.description: A tall panel of broad curling lobed leaves on thick thorny stems, with a shaggy lettuce-like leaf cluster in the middle. At the bottom centre an owl with spread wings perches on a stem and looks straight at the viewer, a crested bird sits below it at the left, a small bird flies left at the top centre, a crested bird flies right at the left middle, a long-necked bird pecks down a stem in the upper centre, and two more birds are cut off by the right edge. Engraved in dark brown line only, with the ground showing through between the hatch lines, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Line work only; the ink is partial alpha and the page shows between the lines, so it reads best on light or cream grounds.
The two flying birds (top centre and left middle) are also delivered as separate cut-outs, upper-flying-day-bird and lower-flying-day-bird.

assets.title: Small bird flying left

assets.title: Five animals in a vine frieze
assets.description: A low engraved frieze of five small animals in a vine of curling stems, lobed leaves and a bunch of grapes. Left to right, a crouching hare faces right, a fox-like animal runs right head down, a curled animal with a bushy striped tail sits in the middle head tucked under, a boar-like animal runs left, and a slender long-tailed animal runs right looking back. Sepia-brown line work with cream hatching on a transparent background; the vine closes in loose scrolls at both ends, so the strip is complete and does not repeat.
usage_notes: Complete finite strip from one plate; both ends close in scrolls, so place it whole as a headpiece or footer band rather than repeating it.
Companion of the bird frieze from the same 1557 series, cut to nearly the same length; the two stack as a matched pair of bands.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1911.604

assets.title: Arabesque cartouche on dark ground
assets.description: A wide symmetrical cartouche printed as a near-black brownish ground with the ornament left in reserve, so the arabesque reads as light lines and leaves cut out of the dark field. The outline is scalloped, with pointed ogee finials at top and bottom centre, two knotted interlace loops over the top finial, scrolled lobes at the four corners and squared bracket terminals at left and right. A band of running scrolls frames an inner field of interlaced strapwork and dense leaf scrolls around a central lozenge. Only the dark ink is opaque; the ornament itself is transparent.
usage_notes: The ornament is the transparent part, so it only reads on a light background; on a dark page the whole piece disappears into a silhouette.
Complete finite cartouche; it works as a label, title plaque or medallion, not as a repeat or frame.

assets.title: Birds and parrots on a flowering frieze
assets.description: An engraved frieze crowded with birds on a thin ground of grass tufts and small flowers, with leafy branches rising between them. Left to right, a small lizard climbs a stem at the far left, a peacock fans its tail, a second peacock walks right trailing its tail, a crested bird perches, a long-necked waterfowl rears with raised wings, birds hover and hang from branches, a crested hook-beaked bird of prey spreads its wings facing left, and several parrots perch among flowers at the right end. Sepia-brown line work with cream hatching on a transparent background; complete, it does not repeat.
usage_notes: Complete finite strip from one plate; the ends are open silhouettes, not a continuous pattern, so place it whole as a headpiece or footer band rather than repeating it.
Companion of the animal frieze from the same 1557 series, cut to nearly the same length; the two stack as a matched pair of bands.
assets.attribution: Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe Hamburg O1911.605

assets.title: Centaur drawing a bow
assets.description: A galloping centaur with a pale human torso, a white coif and a blue dappled horse body draws a red bow, aiming its arrow up and to the right, on a transparent background. The whole figure moves to the right in strict profile.
usage_notes: The figure runs to the right; it sits naturally at the left of a heading or along a bottom margin pointing into the text.

assets.title: Elephant carrying a castle
assets.description: An orange elephant walks to the right carrying a cream stone castle with a red crenellated parapet and a blue domed turret; a hooded man in blue leans out of the castle at the left and a second small figure peers over the battlements at the right. The scene sits on its original opaque panel, red with white vine scroll above and blue with white tendrils below, with a brown ornamental terminal at the upper left; only the area outside the panel is transparent.
usage_notes: The painted panel is part of the asset; place it as a self-contained picture rather than as a cut-out figure.

assets.title: Horse playing pipe and tabor
assets.description: A blue dappled horse stands upright on its hind legs, facing right in profile, blowing a three-hole pipe held in one hand while beating a red-rimmed tabor drum, slung from a red strap over its shoulder, with a curved stick in the other hand. Transparent background.
usage_notes: Tall narrow figure suited to a side margin; it faces right, so place it to the left of the text it accompanies.

assets.title: Rabbit ringing church bells
assets.description: A brown rabbit stands on its hind legs at the left, facing right, and pulls two red twisted bell ropes that hang from the arched doorway of a cream stone church. The church has a blue chevron-tiled roof, a square belfry with two bells, a dark quatrefoil rose window and a tower with a gold cross at the right; the background is transparent.
usage_notes: The rabbit faces into the church, so keep the whole group together; it reads well as a bottom-margin or corner scene.

assets.title: Tall candelabrum panel with a seated satyr and a violin
assets.description: A very tall engraved candelabrum panel between thin vertical rules. From the bottom up, a bearded goat-legged satyr sits before a tasselled pedestal holding a violin and its bow; a blank cartouche between dolphins and trophies of arms; a large fluted urn with a bearded mask and cornucopias curling from its sides; two naked children embracing in a bower of acanthus and vine; a hanging cuirass with plumed helmet and shield; crossed staffs bound with a cord; and a lidded urn at the top among vine leaves and grapes. Dark brown-grey ink; the grey paper tone of the plate is kept at partial opacity.
usage_notes: Extremely tall (about 1:6.6); it works as a full-height side panel or margin filler. The engraved rules along both long edges are part of the master.
The tiers are stacked on one axis, so a crop of a single tier (the satyr base, the urn, the embracing children, the trophy of arms) stands on its own.
The plate area carries a faint grey paper tone, so it sits best on light grounds.

assets.title: Candelabrum panel with dragons, masks and instruments of war
assets.description: A tall symmetrical engraved candelabrum panel. A central shaft rises from a garlanded pedestal through a basket-weave bowl to a wide scale-patterned bowl at the top, where the plate edge cuts it. Two scaly dragons coil at the base; two winged sphinx-like creatures, one human-faced and one lion-headed, perch on the middle bowl facing each other; wheeled cannon jut out to both sides among a drum, a shield, a plumed helmet and a cuirass; two horned masks sprout acanthus at the top corners. Dark brown ink, the tan paper tone kept inside the forms, on a transparent background.
usage_notes: Tall piece (about 1:2.2), symmetrical about the shaft; it reads well as a side panel or centred under a title.
The shaft is cut flat at the top edge of the plate, so place the top against a rule or the page edge, or crop to the lower tiers.
